programs.desc: Albert Lin will use the latest technology to investigate the biblical stories of the parting of the Red Sea and the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.His work will be made easier by satellites and drones.

programs.title: Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programs.desc: A story about the Sovietization process, from 1944 to the construction of the Berlin Wall.After World War II, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe found themselves in the Soviet zone.The events that led to such a division of the Old Continent will be presented.Viewers will learn how it affected the everyday lives of citizens of these countries and what forms of resistance they encountered.Experts will explain the mechanisms of Soviet domination.There will be witnesses' accounts, interviews, discussions of scientific works and archives including propaganda films, home recordings and fictional stories.

programs.title: The Soviet Union
programs.desc: The USSR was established 100 years ago - on December 30, 1922.The filmmakers present archival materials that help answer the question of what fueled the Soviet empire throughout the 20th century.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programs.desc: There have been many cases in history where pilots stopped trusting the readings of the devices on board.The cockpit then became a place of dramatic struggles.The events that took place during the demonstration of the latest product of the French aviation industry will be recalled.A routine training flight of one of the most modern aircraft in the world also had a tragic ending.The machine fell into the Mediterranean Sea.The program also includes a behind-the-scenes look at the Airbus cruise accident that disappeared from radar over the Atlantic.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: Aircraft accident reconstruction.To recreate the events that took place just before the tragedy, the creators present the situations that preceded them.The program will also include comments from specialists.

programs.title: Mayday 13
programs.desc: The series' creators solve the mysteries of the biggest plane crashes.Trying to recreate the events that took place before the tragedies, they reconstruct the situations that preceded them on board the machines.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report 3
programs.desc: Analysis of the most tragic accidents in the history of aviation.The investigation is based on reconstruction of events, photographic materials, accounts of survivors and rescuers, and computer graphics.
